title: Bihar BCECEB Sr. Resident/ Tutor Phase-III Recruitment 2026
summary: Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board (BCECEB) , has released a notification on its official website for the recruitment of Sr. Resident/ Tutor Phase-III Posts. This recruitment is for 575 positions. BCECEB Application Form will start on 02 November 2026 & the candidates can apply until 23 November 2026 . Minimum age required is N/A & The Maximum Age Is 37 – 42 Years ( Category Wise) as on 01 August 2026.
